text: Being here, I feel slightly disoriented by the angular perspectives and glass reflections, as if I have stumbled upon a futuristic laboratory or a showcase of human curiosity. The R+D wall reminds me that knowledge is perpetually in motion, always under development, much like our own understanding of reality. There is a sense of potential and anticipation—the room seems to invite me to question, to explore, and to participate in the great experiment of discovery.
